section.content: 本实用新型公开了一种用于生物基因工程用生物细胞储存箱，包括箱体，所述箱体的内壁固定连接有安置座，所述安置座的顶部开设有试管槽，所述试管槽的内壁固定连接有海绵垫，所述试管槽的内壁固定连接有连接板，所述连接板的外壁固定连接有伸缩杆，所述伸缩杆的一端固定连接有固定板。通过设置的复位弹簧、弹力布等结构，使试管的保护效果更好，将试管放到试管槽中的海绵垫的内侧，使固定板和夹持块对试管进行限位，然后移动弹力布，使弹力布的一端穿过定位条的下方并进行翻转，使两个魔术贴贴合，对试管进行固定，试管在复位弹簧和弹力布弹力的作用下进行固定，有效防止移动装置时试管产生的晃动，起到更好的保护试管的效果。

The utility model discloses a be used for biological cell bin for biological genetic engineering, the power distribution box comprises a box body, the inner wall fixedly connected with seat of box, the test-tube groove has been seted up at the top of seat of placing, the inner wall fixedly connected with foam-rubber cushion in test-tube groove, the inner wall fixedly connected with connecting plate in test-tube groove, the outer wall fixedly connected with telescopic link of connecting plate, the one end fixedly connected with fixed plate of telescopic link. Through the reset spring who sets up, elasticity cloth isotructure, make the protection effect of test tube better, place the inboard of the foam-rubber cushion in the test tube groove with the test tube, it is spacing to make fixed plate and grip block carry out the test tube, then remove elasticity cloth, the below that the one end that makes elasticity cloth passed the location strip is carried out and is overturn, make two magic subsides laminating, fix the test tube, the test tube is fixed under reset spring and elasticity cloth effect of elasticity, what the test tube produced when effectively preventing the mobile device rocks, play the effect of better protection test tube.

Biological cell storage box for biological gene engineeringTechnical Field

The utility model belongs to the technical field of genetic engineering, concretely relates to be used for biological gene engineering to use biological cell bin.

Background

The gene engineering is also called gene splicing technology and DNA recombination technology, and is a genetic technology which takes molecular genetics as a theoretical basis and takes modern methods of molecular biology and microbiology as means to construct hybrid DNA molecules in vitro from genes from different sources according to a pre-designed blueprint and then introduce the hybrid DNA molecules into living cells so as to change the original genetic characteristics of organisms, obtain new varieties and produce new products. The gene engineering technology provides a powerful means for the research of the structure and the function of the gene. In the process of genetic engineering research, biological cell storage boxes for biological genetic engineering are required to be used for storing cells.

However, the conventional apparatus has the following problems in use:

1. because traditional device is poor at the protection effect that removes the in-process to the test tube, the test tube vibrates in the inside easy emergence of device to cause the test tube breakage, the cell outflow.

2. When the traditional device is used, the cells in each test tube can be judged only by manually sequencing the test tubes, so that the use is troublesome.

SUMMERY OF THE UTILITY MODEL

The utility model aims to overcome the defects in the prior art and provide a biological cell storage box for biological gene engineering, which has the advantages of good protection effect and convenient use.

In order to achieve the above object, the utility model provides a following technical scheme: the utility model provides a be used for biological cell bin for biological genetic engineering, the power distribution box comprises a box body, the inner wall fixedly connected with mount pad of box, the test-tube groove has been seted up at mount pad's top, the inner wall fixedly connected with foam-rubber cushion of test-tube groove, the inner wall fixedly connected with connecting plate of test-tube groove, the outer wall fixedly connected with telescopic link of connecting plate, the one end fixedly connected with fixed plate of telescopic link, just be located the outside fixedly connected with reset spring of telescopic link between the outer wall of fixed plate and connecting plate, the outer wall fixedly connected with grip block of fixed plate, mount pad's outer wall fixedly connected with has elasticity cloth and location strip, elasticity cloth twines in the outside of location strip, two magic subsides of the outer wall fixedly connected with of elasticity cloth, two the outer wall of magic subsides bonds.

Through the technical scheme, upwards promote the fixed plate and make the reset spring shrink the back, place the inboard of the foam-rubber cushion in the test tube groove with the test tube, then loosen the fixed plate, the fixed plate resets under reset spring's effect, it is spacing to make fixed plate and grip block carry out the test tube, then remove elasticity cloth, the below that the one end that makes elasticity cloth passed the location strip and overturn, make two magic subsides laminating, fix the test tube, the test tube is fixed under reset spring and elasticity cloth effect, what the test tube produced when effectively preventing the mobile device rocks, play the effect of better protection test tube.

Preferably, the inner wall of the setting seat is connected with a transparent label plate in a rotating mode, a finger groove is formed in one side, located on the transparent label plate, of the outer wall of the setting seat, a positioning block is fixedly connected to the outer wall of the transparent label plate, a rubber block is fixedly connected to the upper portion of the positioning block, of the inner wall of the setting seat, the outer wall of the rubber block is attached to the outer wall of the positioning block, and a label groove is formed in the outer wall of the transparent label plate.

Through above-mentioned technical scheme, the back is placed to the test tube, inserts the finger groove of test tube top with the finger, gets up transparent label plate upset, then inserts the label of this test tube information of record in the label groove to make things convenient for the staff to distinguish the cell in every test tube, reduced work load, use convenience more, after the label was placed, the transparent label plate of gyration made the locating piece card in the below of block rubber, thereby fixed transparent label plate.

Preferably, the inside in test tube groove is provided with the test tube, the outer wall laminating with the outer wall of foam-rubber cushion, fixed plate, grip block and elasticity cloth respectively of test tube.

Through above-mentioned technical scheme, the test tube is spacing jointly by foam-rubber cushion, fixed plate, grip block and elasticity cloth, and the effectual test tube that has prevented is removing the in-process and is taking place the vibration, avoids the test tube to take place to break, causes the cell to preserve the failure.

Preferably, the inner wall of one side of the box body is fixedly connected with a liquid nitrogen inlet pipe and an exhaust pipe, the outer walls of the liquid nitrogen inlet pipe and the exhaust pipe are fixedly connected with electromagnetic valves, and the outer wall of the box body is fixedly connected with a control panel.

Through above-mentioned technical scheme, place the test tube inside the box, through opening and closing of control panel control solenoid valve, earlier through the air suction of exhaust tube in with the box, then let in the pipe through the liquid nitrogen and add the liquid nitrogen to the box in, provide suitable living environment for biological cell, ensure the activity of cell.

Preferably, the outer wall of box articulates there is the case lid, the top of case lid is rotated and is connected with the handle.

Through above-mentioned technical scheme, the case lid is used for sealing the box, and the handle is convenient to be mentioned equipment when needing, removes.

Preferably, the outer wall fixedly connected with latch fitting of case lid, the case lid passes through latch fitting and box fixed connection.

Through above-mentioned technical scheme, the latch fitting can be in the same place case lid and box locking, when guaranteeing the device leakproofness, prevents that the case lid from opening by mistake.

Preferably, the outer wall of the bottom of the box body is relatively and fixedly connected with a damping base.

Through above-mentioned technical scheme, vibration that vibration damping mount can produce when placing the device cushions, prevents to cause the damage to the test tube in the box.

Compared with the prior art, the beneficial effects of the utility model are that:

1. through the reset spring that sets up, elasticity cloth isotructure, make the protection effect of test tube better, place the inboard of the foam-rubber cushion in the test tube groove with the test tube, the fixed plate resets under reset spring's effect, it is spacing to make fixed plate and grip block carry on the test tube, then remove elasticity cloth, the below that the one end that makes elasticity cloth passed the location strip and overturn, make two magic subsides laminating, fix the test tube, the test tube is fixed under reset spring and elasticity cloth effect, what the test tube produced when effectively preventing the mobile device rocks, play the effect of better protection test tube.

2. Through the transparent label board isotructure that sets up, make the device use convenience more, the back is placed to the test tube, insert the finger groove of test tube top with the finger, get up transparent label board upset, then the label that will take notes this test tube information inserts in the label groove, thereby make things convenient for the staff to distinguish the cell in every test tube, the work load has been reduced, use convenience more, after the label is placed, the transparent label board of gyration, make the locating piece card in the below of block rubber, thereby fix transparent label board.

Detailed Description

The technical solutions in the embodiments of the present invention will be described clearly and completely with reference to the accompanying drawings in the embodiments of the present invention, and it is obvious that the described embodiments are only some embodiments of the present invention, not all embodiments. Based on the embodiments in the present invention, all other embodiments obtained by a person skilled in the art without creative work belong to the protection scope of the present invention.

The first embodiment is as follows:

referring to fig. 1-4, the present invention provides a technical solution: the utility model provides a biological cell bin for biological genetic engineering, the power distribution box comprises a box body 1, box 1's inner wall fixedly connected with arrangement seat 2, test-tube groove 3 has been seted up at arrangement seat 2's top, test-tube groove 3's inner wall fixedly connected with foam-rubber cushion 4, test-tube groove 3's inner wall fixedly connected with connecting plate 5, connecting plate 5's outer wall fixedly connected with telescopic link 6, telescopic link 6's one end fixedly connected with fixed plate 7, just be located telescopic link 6's outside fixedly connected with reset spring 8 between fixed plate 7 and connecting plate 5's the outer wall, the outer wall fixedly connected with grip block 9 of fixed plate 7, arrangement seat 2's outer wall fixedly connected with elasticity cloth 10 and location strip 11, elasticity cloth 10 twines in the outside of location strip 11, two magic subsides of the outer wall fixedly connected with of elasticity cloth 10, the outer wall bonding of two magic subsides.

In this embodiment, make the shrink back of reset spring 8 through upwards promoting fixed plate 7, put test tube 17 the inboard of the foam-rubber cushion 4 in test tube groove 3, then loosen fixed plate 7, fixed plate 7 resets under reset spring 8's effect, it is spacing to make fixed plate 7 and grip block 9 carry out test tube 17, then remove elasticity cloth 10, the below that makes elasticity cloth 10 pass location strip 11 is and overturn, make two magic subsides laminating, fix test tube 17, test tube 17 fixes under the effect of reset spring 8 and elasticity cloth 10 elasticity, the rocking that test tube 17 produced when effectively preventing the mobile device, play better protection test tube 17's effect.

Example two:

In this embodiment, test tube 17 places the back, insert the finger groove 13 of test tube 17 top with the finger, turn over transparent label board 12, then insert the label of this test tube 17 information of record in label groove 16, thereby make things convenient for the staff to distinguish the cell in every test tube 17, and the work load has been reduced, and it is more convenient to use, and after the label was placed, transparent label board 12 revolves, makes locating piece 14 card in the below of rubber block 15, thereby fix transparent label board 12.

Example three:

referring to fig. 1-7, based on the first embodiment and the second embodiment, the present invention provides a technical solution: test tube groove 3's inside is provided with test tube 17, test tube 17's outer wall respectively with foam-rubber cushion 4, fixed plate 7, the outer wall laminating of grip block 9 and elasticity cloth 10, one side inner wall fixedly connected with liquid nitrogen of box 1 lets in pipe 18 and exhaust tube 19, the equal fixedly connected with solenoid valve 20 of outer wall that the liquid nitrogen lets in pipe 18 and exhaust tube 19, box 1's outer wall fixedly connected with control panel 21, box 1's outer wall articulates there is case lid 22, case lid 22's top is rotated and is connected with handle 23, case lid 22's outer wall fixedly connected with latch fitting 24, case lid 22 passes through latch fitting 24 and box 1 fixed connection, the relative fixedly connected with vibration damping mount 25 of bottom outer wall of box 1.

In this embodiment, the test tube 17 is limited by the sponge cushion 4, the fixing plate 7, the clamping block 9 and the elastic cloth 10, so as to effectively prevent the test tube 17 from vibrating during the moving process, thereby preventing the test tube 17 from breaking and causing cell preservation failure, the test tube 17 is placed in the box body 1, the electromagnetic valve 20 is controlled to be opened and closed by the control panel 21, air in the box body 1 is firstly sucked by the air suction pipe 19, then liquid nitrogen is added into the box body 1 through the liquid nitrogen inlet pipe 18 to provide a proper living environment for biological cells, the activity of the cells is ensured, the box cover 22 is used for sealing the box body 1, the handle 23 is convenient for lifting the device when needed, the device is moved, the box cover 22 and the box body 1 can be locked by the locking piece 24, the sealing performance of the device is ensured, meanwhile, the box cover 22 is prevented from being opened mistakenly, the vibration generated when the device is placed can be buffered by the damping base 25, damage to the test tube 17 in the case 1 is prevented.

The utility model discloses a theory of operation and use flow: when in use, after the locking piece 24 is opened, the box cover 22 is opened, then the test tube 17 with biological cells is taken out, the fixing plate 7 is pushed upwards to enable the reset spring 8 to contract, the test tube 17 is placed on the inner side of the spongy cushion 4 in the test tube groove 3, then the fixing plate 7 is loosened, the fixing plate 7 resets under the action of the reset spring 8, the fixing plate 7 and the clamping block 9 limit the test tube 17, then the elastic cloth 10 is moved, one end of the elastic cloth 10 penetrates through the lower part of the positioning strip 11 and overturns, two magic tapes are attached to the fixing plate, the test tube 17 is fixed under the action of the elastic forces of the reset spring 8 and the elastic cloth 10, the test tube 17 is effectively prevented from shaking during moving, the better effect of protecting the test tube 17 is achieved, after the test tube 17 is placed, the finger is inserted into the finger groove 13 above the test tube 17, the transparent label plate 12 is overturned, then insert the label of this test tube 17 information of record in the label groove 16, thereby make things convenient for the staff to distinguish the cell in every test tube 17, the work load has been reduced, it is more convenient to use, after the label is placed, gyration transparent label board 12, make locating piece 14 card in the below of block rubber 15, thereby fix transparent label board 12, after placing, after finishing, after locking case lid 22, take out the inside air of box 1 through exhaust tube 19, then let in pipe 18 through the liquid nitrogen and add the liquid nitrogen in to box 1, preserve the cell.
